results.title: Retaliation Threatened if the UK Joins EU Tariffs on Chinese Electric Vehicles - autoevolution
results.snippet:
For the time being, as highlighted by Automotive News, the United Kingdom still applies its 10 percent import tariff to China-made vehicles of all types. The EU has added specific duties aimed at Chinese battery-electric vehicles, and you are correct to view those duties as a protectionist response.
